name: cyber-runner
description: Offline camera-controlled 3D exhibition runner with separate player and operator displays.
author: Rashmika Nishshanka

scripts.test: node --test physics.test.mjs tracking.test.mjs motion.test.mjs animation-sync.test.mjs arcade.test.mjs powerups.test.mjs display-link.test.mjs player-guide.test.mjs desktop.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run assets:check && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.desktop:build: npm run check && npm run assets:check && npm test && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win --x64 --publish never
